[SWS_CM_00352] Execution Context for enabling service Trigger trigger
⌈
For the SetReceiveHandlermethod described in [SWS_CM_00250] a second over-
load with an additional input parameter shall be provided. This parameter shall provide an executioner object in which any asynchronous computation spawn by SetReceive-
Handler shall be invoked. The minimum behavior of the Execution Context is defined
in [SWS_CM_11364].
template<typename ExecutorT>
ara::core::Result<void> Trigger::SetReceiveHandler(
ara::com::EventReceiveHandler handler, ExecutorT&& executor);
For the first overload without an execution context argument an implementation defined
default execution context (like in previous AUTOSAR releases) shall be used.
